none: PAS FindID 1008878: Roman coin. Silver denarius of Domitian
contea di ritrovamento: Doncaster (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ [IMP] CAES DOMI T AVG GERM PM TR P X ; R/ IMP XXI COS XV CENS P P P

A complete silver denarius of Domitian (AD 81-96), dating to AD 90. RIC 689, (RIC [1962] 147), RSC 261, BMC 164, Sear 2734. Obverse description: Laureate head right. Obverse inscription: [IMP] CAES DOMI T AVG GERM PM TR P X. Reverse description: Minerva advancing right, brandishing javelin & holding shield. Reverse inscription: IMP XXI COS XV CENS P P P. Diameter: 19.09 mm; Thickness: 2.01 mm; Weight: 3.31g
